title: fix(plugin-detail): a milestone's completed row is not hidden as a completed task (objectui#12106)
body:
Fixes #12106

Clause-②: no

## What changes

A `sys_activity` row of type `completed` that an object's `activityMilestones` entry fired ("Case resolved", "Case closed", a task's own "Task completed") is no longer read as a completed task. plugin-audit stamps such a row with `metadata.kind: 'milestone'` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22771, landed by objectstack-ai/objectstack#22783 as `8bd0fcd07f`). `activityRowToFeedItem` now reads that marker on a row that would land on a feed type `showCompleted` hides, and maps it to `system`. A row without the marker maps exactly as before.

This is route B from the card's triage ruling (comment `6105608877`), under the unlock's landing condition (comment `6106890335`): an unmarked `completed` row behaves as today, hidden under `showCompleted`'s default.

## Both readers

One change covers both console reads of `sys_activity`, because both hand raw, unprojected rows to this one mapper:

- the `record:activity` block's self-fetch (`record-activity.tsx`, its `dataSource.find('sys_activity', …)`);
- the console record page's merged feed (`RecordDetailView`, its `sys_activity` read), which feeds the `record:discussion` block on the synthesized default page. That reader calling the exported mapper is already pinned by `RecordDetailView.activityUnmappedType-5896.test.tsx` ("IDENTITY — the merge builds its items with the exported `activityRowToFeedItem`").

## Why `system`, and not `task` with a `showCompleted` exemption

Measured against every reader of `FeedItem.type` in the tree:

| reader | `system` (this PR) | `task` plus an exemption |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filterMode: 'tasks_only'` (`RecordActivityTimeline`, `filterItems`) | a milestone is not listed as a task | "Case resolved" listed as a task |
| `types: ['task']` allow-list (`applyFeedConfig`) | tasks only | also selects milestones |
| `showCompleted` (`COMPLETED_FEED_TYPES`) | stays exact: `task` is produced only by completed activities | needs a per-item exemption |
| icon and colour (`FEED_TYPE_ICONS`, `FEED_TYPE_COLORS`) | what every other author-typed milestone already gets (`escalated` falls to `system`), and what app-shell's `ActivityItem` surface gives `completed` (`activityItemType.ts`) | check-square, green |
| `unifiedTimeline: false` | kept | kept |
| what must be carried past the mapper | nothing: the type is decided where the raw row is in hand | a new `FeedItem` member in `@object-ui/types`, set by every host feed |

The exemption route would also move a published type (`FeedItem`), which `Clause-②: no` rules out. The cost of `system`: on a page with `showCompleted: true`, a milestone `completed` row that used to draw with the task icon now draws with the system icon.

## The served shape

`sys_activity.metadata` is a `textarea` column described as "JSON-serialized additional context". The writer stores it with `safeStringify`, the redaction re-serialises it, and the writer's own test (`activity-milestone-kind.integration.test.ts`) reads the served row with `JSON.parse(r.metadata)`. So the reader parses that JSON string and reads nothing else. An already-parsed object is not read as the marker: no served row carries one, and reading both would be a second dialect (AGENTS.md #0.1). A string that is not a JSON object, or a `kind` other than `'milestone'` (an app may write `kind: 'email'`), is "no marker".

## Docs

- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`: a new paragraph after the mapping paragraph says what a milestone row does, and the `showCompleted` input row and the produced-kinds table say the same. The props listing's `showCompleted` comment now reads "Include completed activities" (the spec's description) instead of "Show completed tasks". The new paragraph sits outside the anchored mapping paragraph, so `docsActivityMapTranscription-7876.test.ts` still reads exactly the map's transcription.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`: the block registration's `showCompleted` input description gains one sentence saying a milestone row shows either way. This change made that text false for milestone rows, so it is corrected here. No other open PR touches the file (read while writing this, with a control leg).
- `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` names `showCompleted` but does not describe the mapping, so it is unchanged.

## Pins

New file `recordActivityFeed.milestoneKind-12106.test.tsx`, 16 tests:

- a milestone row is shown under `showCompleted`'s default (`record:discussion`, the default page's block);
- CONTROL: a `completed` row with no marker is hidden by default, as today (the v17 face), on `record:discussion` and `record:activity`;
- CONTROL: `showCompleted: true` shows both;
- a task's own completion milestone, on that task's own page, is shown;
- the mapping itself: a marked row maps to `system`; six CONTROL shapes still map to `task` (no `metadata`, the change without a `kind`, an app's own `kind`, non-JSON, a JSON array, an already-parsed object); the marker moves no `updated`, `scheduled` or `system` row; `types: ['task']` still selects tasks only;
- one DOM pin through the `record:activity` self-fetch: "Case resolved" renders and the unmarked completion does not.

### Ablation, both directions (from committed `0ef756b`, each restore proven)

Driven by objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (the anchor must hit once, the blob must change, the restore is proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), inside a bash EXIT/INT/TERM trap that repeats the same proof. The test imports the module by relative path, so the run reads `src` and no `dist/` rebuild is involved.

1. Marker read removed (`isMilestoneActivityRow(row)` replaced by `false`): 7 failed, 9 passed. The 7 are the milestone pins, as predicted. Restored: blob `25b2756a8306` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. Over-broad reader (every `completed` row treated as a milestone): 10 failed, 6 passed. The 10 are every CONTROL, the `types: ['task']` pin and the DOM pin. Restored the same way.
